prediction_source: unchanged original float64 predictions.parquet, not B1/B2

smoothing.calendar: sorted unique raw-panel market dates; immediately previous market day only
smoothing.fallback: today original on validation first day, year/model boundary or missing exact previous-day prediction
smoothing.missing_day: no older borrowing, no backward fill
smoothing.future: never read future prediction for current output

comparison.annual: official evaluator against all three same-year controls; equal-weight three-year mean delta
comparison.monthly: aggregate full-year daily metrics; first monthly turnover retains previous eligible day
comparison.cross_year_conflict: both positive and negative annual deltas; report any negative separately
comparison.interpretation: descriptive flags only; no statistical significance or automatic acceptance; disclose IC/return costs and invalid-price turnover Top
